description: R53 combined long+short intraday pullback-breakout. Long mid-strength gainers on NIFTY-up days; deep-loser shorts on NIFTY-down days. Shared 60k/2-slot pool, EOD flatten.

capital._notes: margin/slot = base_capital/slots; notional/slot = margin*leverage. sizing_mode: fixed | compound | capped.

windows_ist._notes: no_trade[1] == afternoon[0] (same boundary). afternoon start tunable 12:00/13:00/14:00. eod_flatten strictly < 15:15 MIS square-off enforced upstream; 15:15 places exits before broker square-off.

short._notes: Deep-loser band (-5,-3] is the edge; mid-strength (-1,-2.5] and nf_mom/noreentry/1pm-reselect all REJECTED. Most slippage-fragile leg.

backtest.universe: 163 stocks / 15 sectors, real NIFTY+15 sector indices, real Zerodha charges, slippage NOT modelled

parity_target._notes: Dashboard Backtest column (issue #508). Combined fixed-sizing book on Rs60k: PF 1.60, +97.6% (= Rs58,564 on the Rs60k base = long Rs44,202 + short Rs14,362), Sharpe 2.96, MaxDD -8.9%, 15/21 months positive. cagr_pct is deliberately null: the headline +97.6% is FIXED (non-reinvested) sizing, so annualizing it would misrepresent the compounding basis. Per-side win_rate_pct is omitted because the R53 report publishes per-side trade count / PF / net only, never a per-side win rate - the UI renders those cells '-' rather than inventing them. SLIPPAGE IS NOT MODELLED in any of these figures (LEARNINGS open risk #1); expect the sandbox column to trail this, most of all on the deep-loser short.

llm_context.framing: Intraday T+0 pullback-breakout. Long book buys mid-strength (+1..+2.5%) sector-aligned gainers on a no-supply pullback then volume breakout; short book sells deep losers (-3..-5%) on a no-supply bounce then volume breakdown. All positions flat by 15:15. The veto reviews per-signal setup quality / regime fit, not overnight risk (no overnight hold).
